spiritgiven.comments: thank you for the great game, we loved your self control and how you managed to discuss and have a positive attitude even if there were some moments were it was difficult to do so. Grazie mille a tutti e buona fortuna!

we gave a 0 in fair mindedness because we heard bad comments on the side line in their language (which we understand). Those comment were encouraging them to contest calls to have advantages for the game. They didn’t listen to our point of view during the calls. They made bad comments on the side when they were scored and we think the game didn’t need that tension since they were winning and they were advantaged. In the end, we liked the intensity of the game and how they never stopped fighting.

we gave a 0 to fair mindedness because we felt that sometimes your players didn’t actually want to give their opinion on the calls, some of your players reacted in a nervous way towards our calls and we noticed that on the side there wasn’t a friendly attitude. Anyways, we felt that even if the game was a very tense one you kept your intensity high and we really appreciated that. good luck!

hi USA! it was an honor to play with you, a dream for most of us. We learnt a lot from your fair-mindedness and we loved to see a team as close as you. You always cheered, screamed and talked to your mates on the field from the side and it seemed liked you were all together on the field and not only 7. thank you, it’s an experience we’ll always bring with us and remember. love you, good luck and go high!❤️

We think the spirit really improved since the last game, though (and we explained it in the circle) we felt that some contacts were still not impacting on the game, some others were dealt with a little bit of frustration and contested in any case. Thank you for listening to us and trying to improve.

we think it was a very intense and beautiful game and despite that you managed to keep a good spirit and always be correct and respectful on the calls. We also really loved your smiles on the line and your kindness, thank you❤️

spiritreceived.comments:
Italy mixed, thank you for this nice game. We gave you a 1 on fouls and body contact because our team thought the contact sometimes to
much as we told you in the Spirit circle. We do want to compliment you on your communication. Me as spirit captain and also the other players of out team thought you were very clear in calls and we liked that very much. Thank you again for this very nice and intense game and we hope to see you again this tournament and mabyr beat you then :).
Good luck NED(X)

In the first few points we really liked the spirit of the game. But after that the „rules, knowledge and use“ and „fair mindedness“ went down a lot. How you did the double team was unspirited. It can‘t be that we point it out to your captain, spirit captain and coaches several times and it toke all a lot of time till it changed. From our perspective this gave you an unfair advantage.  Thank you for you good communication. Except this issue we like the game a lot and enjoyed your attitude.

Rules-Some are not aware of the rules, especially unjustified travel calls, and inconsistent calls towards the end of the game. Unaware of stoppage calls, causing a few violation
Fouls- Non-Incidental Fouls at times
Fair mindessness- They make unbiased calls respecting the spirit of the game

We had the feeling that the body contact during the game was always a bit too much for us. At the peak of the intensity of said contact we felt that you made way too dangerous bids and ended up injuring our players. Afterwards it got better but it was still too physical. Still thank you for this intense game and we loved your high fives on the sideline!

They say that a releasing a disc that is not spinning is a violation, while it not.
There are blocking fouls in zone defense
Lack of body control when defending

Team Italy did a great job at keeping positive and spirited throughout a very competitive match. Although we did not bring this up during games we believe that team Italy was committing many marking violations by being too close on the mark.

Sentimos que escucharon las recomendaciones y mejoraron mucho en comparación con el partido pasado, sin embargo, sentimos que aún tienen que mejorar mucho la forma en la que reciben los llamados, sentimos que en la mayoría reaccionaron negativamente tanto en la línea como dentro del juego. Agradecemos la intensidad y que se redujo el contacto físico.
We feel that they listened to the recommendations and improved a lot compared to the last game, however, we feel that they still have to improve a lot in the way they receive the calls, we feel that the majority reacted negatively both on the line and within the game. We appreciate the intensity and that physical contact was reduced.
